tips.text: Run long endless Zariman missions as Omnia relic fissures; Eximus spawn more the longer you stay.
Awaken Void Angels for clusters of three or four Entropic Eximus; Mobile Defense always has one near an objective.
Skip Steel Path; it gives no extra Entropic Kuva per kill.
Hold the elevator panel to extract solo; otherwise the whole squad leaves together.
Expect one to two hours of endless missions for the 400 Entropic Kuva.
